# ADR-3031: A03: NoSQL operator injection for document query 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

JSON operators like $gt alter query intent.

## Decision

APIs MUST NOT accept a NoSQL operator injection for document query 7 (A03-7) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Strip operator keys from user documents.
